title: Higher direct images along a morphism of sites are sheafified cohomology presheaves
statement: Let $f:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a morphism of sites given by the continuous functor $u:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (3), $f_*=u^s$, and let $R^qf_*:\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ ($q\ge0$) be the right derived functors of the left exact functor $f_*$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $R^qf_*\mathcal F=\mathcal H^q(f_*\mathcal I^\bullet)$ (cohomology computed in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$) for an injective resolution $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ and $q\ge0$ let $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}$ be the presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal D$ with $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}(V)=H^q(u(V),\mathcal F)=H^q(\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V)))$ ($H^q$ over an object, [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2)), the restriction along $V'\to V$ being induced by the restriction maps $\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V))\to\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V'))$. Then the canonical map of presheaves $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}\to R^qf_*\mathcal F$ (sending the class of a cocycle $s\in\mathcal I^q(u(V))=(f_*\mathcal I^q)(V)$ to the section of the cohomology sheaf it defines) identifies $R^qf_*\mathcal F$ with the sheafification $(\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F})^\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]; in particular $R^qf_*\mathcal F=0$ if and only if $(\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F})^\#=0$.
